timothy1.1.p1.b1.text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the command of God our Savior and of Christ Jesus our hope,

timothy1.1.p1.b2.text: To Timothy, my true child in the faith:

timothy1.1.p1.b3.text: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

timothy1.1.p2.b1.text: As I urged you on my departure to Macedonia, you should stay on at Ephesus

timothy1.1.p2.b2.text: to instruct certain men not to teach false doctrines or devote themselves to myths and endless genealogies,

timothy1.1.p2.b3.text: which promote speculation rather than the stewardship of God’s work, which is by faith.

timothy1.1.p2.b4.text: The goal of our instruction is the love …

timothy1.1.p3.b1.text: Now we know that the law is good, if one uses it legitimately.

timothy1.1.p3.b2.text: … law is not enacted for the righteous, but for the lawless and rebellious, …

timothy1.1.p3.b3.text: that agrees with the glorious gospel of the blessed God, with which I have been entrusted.

timothy1.1.p4.b1.text: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has strengthened me, that He considered me faithful and appointed me to service.

timothy1.1.p4.b2.text: I was formerly a blasphemer, a persecutor, and a violent man;

timothy1.1.p4.b3.text: … I was shown mercy. And the grace of our Lord overflowed to me, along with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.

timothy1.1.p5.b1.text: This is a trustworthy saying, worthy of full acceptance: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am the worst.

timothy1.1.p5.b2.text: But for this very reason I was shown mercy, so that in me, the worst of sinners, Christ Jesus might display His perfect patience as an example to those who would believe in Him for eternal life.

timothy1.1.p5.b3.text: Now to the King eternal, immortal, and invisible, the only God, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.

timothy1.1.p6.b1.text: Timothy, my child, I entrust you with this command in keeping with the previous prophecies about you, so that by them you may fight the good fight,

timothy1.1.p6.b2.text: … a good conscience, which some have rejected and thereby shipwrecked their faith.

timothy1.1.p6.b3.text: Among them are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have handed over to Satan to be taught not to blaspheme.
